issue: CapacityUnits='bcm/y' with Capacity='3.50' is anomalous — every other Japanese LNG terminal in the export uses mtpa. Likely a units-field error; 3.5 bcm/y vaporized gas would be roughly ~2.5 mtpa, but the intended figure is unclear for this cancelled (2023) proposal.
suggested_action: Verify whether 3.50 was intended as mtpa or bcm/y and normalize CapacityUnits to mtpa per GEM convention; low priority (cancelled terminal).

suggested_action: Optionally reconcile start year against JERA (1988) vs GEM (1987); not material. Left GEM value unchanged.
